name: 2one Design System — authored decision layer
description: The part of the knowledge graph that cannot be derived from code: user intents, contexts, states, accessibility requirements, button variants, and the semantic decision edges (preferred_for, preferred_over, inappropriate_for, requires, ...). Rules themselves live in rules/ux-rules.json (the authoritative contract, with severity + precedence); this file references them by id. Everything here is provenance=explicit (authored policy). `source` on each item points at the real repository artifact that states or justifies it. build-graph.mjs merges this with the derived structural graph.

intent.label: Present pricing
intent.description: Explain plans and convert a visitor to a paid plan.

intent.label: Primary action
intent.description: The single most important action in a view or section.

intent.label: Low-emphasis action
intent.description: A secondary/tertiary action that must not compete with the primary.

intent.label: Destructive action
intent.description: An action that deletes or irreversibly changes data.

intent.label: Confirm an action
intent.description: Ask the user to confirm before proceeding.

intent.label: Submit a form
intent.description: Send the data the user has entered.

intent.label: Authenticate
intent.description: Sign in or sign up.

intent.label: Navigate
intent.description: Move between views or destinations.

intent.label: Show supplementary info
intent.description: Reveal optional, non-essential helper information.

intent.label: Convey essential information
intent.description: Information the user MUST perceive to succeed (required, error, or instruction).

intent.label: Select an option
intent.description: Choose one or more values from a set.

intent.label: Recover from an error
intent.description: Understand and fix an invalid input.

intent.label: Signal the agent is working
intent.description: Tell the user the agent is working right now, and on what.

intent.label: Signal the agent is composing
intent.description: Lightweight presence cue that a reply is coming, with no named step.

intent.label: Stream an answer
intent.description: Show an assistant answer as its tokens arrive.

intent.label: Show the reasoning trace
intent.description: Reveal the model's intermediate steps without dominating the answer.

intent.label: Report reasoning effort
intent.description: Show how hard to think and how much of that budget was spent.

intent.label: Hold the frame before first output
intent.description: Keep the frame while the model has nothing to show yet.

intent.label: Refuse with a safe alternative
intent.description: Decline a request and offer the nearest thing the agent can do instead.

intent.label: Post to a feed
intent.description: Show one item in a social/activity feed — author, body, optional media, low-emphasis reactions.

intent.label: Show a profile
intent.description: Introduce a person/account at the top of a profile — avatar, name, bio, stats, one primary relationship action.

intent.label: Show a comment thread
intent.description: Show a thread of comments and let the reader add one.

intent.label: Show a media gallery
intent.description: Show a set of images/videos as a browsable grid or carousel, with a lightbox.

intent.label: App shell
intent.description: The top-level product frame — brand, navigation, and a content region.

intent.label: Show a side panel
intent.description: A secondary panel beside the main content — inline on desktop, a Sheet on mobile.

intent.label: Action toolbar
intent.description: A row of controls where a critical action must stay reachable.

intent.label: Show a media placeholder
intent.description: An on-brand stand-in where an image or video will go but none is loaded.

intent.label: Dashboard
intent.description: An overview dashboard: KPI tiles, a data table and charts.

intent.label: Stat tiles / KPIs
intent.description: A row of KPI / metric tiles.

intent.label: Data table
intent.description: A sortable, selectable table of records.

intent.label: Chart
intent.description: A chart or data visualisation.

intent.label: Login
intent.description: A sign-in screen.

intent.label: Signup
intent.description: A create-account screen.

context.label: Desktop / md+
context.description: Viewport at the md breakpoint and above.

context.label: Confirmation flow
context.description: A step that gates an action behind explicit confirmation.

a11y.label: APCA + WCAG contrast
a11y.description: Text/UI pairs must clear their APCA Lc threshold, audited light and dark.

a11y.label: Never signal state by colour alone
a11y.description: State must carry an icon, label, or shape in addition to colour.

a11y.label: Visible focus indicator
a11y.description: A focusable control must show a focus ring (Lc 15 non-text floor).

a11y.label: Accessible label
a11y.description: Inputs and controls must have a programmatic label.

a11y.label: Keyboard operable
a11y.description: All interactive controls must be reachable and operable by keyboard.

a11y.label: Focus management
a11y.description: Overlays must trap and restore focus.

a11y.label: Scrim behind text over media
a11y.description: Never place text directly over media — lay a scrim behind it.

pattern.label: Pricing page
pattern.description: Complete pricing-page composition: plans (Card + billing toggle + recommended) then comparison Table, FAQ and CTA. One primary action; included/excluded shown by icon + text.

pattern.label: Form submission
pattern.description: Label + Input + validation message, one primary submit.

pattern.label: Destructive confirmation
pattern.description: AlertDialog gating a destructive action, confirmed by a destructive button.

pattern.label: Authentication
pattern.description: Sign-in / sign-up composed from Card + Label + Input + Button.

pattern.label: Mobile side panel
pattern.description: A panel that renders inline on md+ and as a Sheet on mobile.

pattern.label: Feed item
pattern.description: One feed post: a Card with an author Item (Avatar), body, optional media placeholder, and a row of ghost reaction Buttons. No primary — reactions are low-emphasis.

pattern.label: Profile header
pattern.description: Profile top: large Avatar, name/handle, bio, a stats row, and exactly one primary relationship Button (Follow / Edit).

pattern.label: Comment thread
pattern.description: A list of comment Items (Avatar + body) plus a single Textarea composer with one primary Post button.

pattern.label: Media gallery
pattern.description: Media as a grid/Carousel of Cards with a Dialog lightbox; Empty when there are none. Text over media sits on a scrim.

variant.label: Primary Button
variant.description: Button variant=default — the one solid primary action.

ai-component.label: Thinking indicator
ai-component.description: A live status line naming the current step, with elapsed time. Reasoning category.

ai-component.label: Typing indicator
ai-component.description: Three grayscale dots signalling the assistant is composing. Reasoning category.

ai-component.label: Streaming text
ai-component.description: Answer tokens revealed over time; the leading edge carries the brand accent, then settles to ink. Reasoning category.

ai-component.label: Reasoning panel
ai-component.description: A collapsible timeline of reasoning steps that settles into a summary. Reasoning category.

ai-component.label: Reasoning effort
ai-component.description: Effort level (label + segment shape) and budget spent vs allotted. Reasoning category.

ai-component.label: Loading state
ai-component.description: A pixel matrix + Skeleton holding the frame before the first token. Reasoning category.

ai-component.label: Guardrail notice
ai-component.description: A refusal in its own (grayscale) shape, offering the nearest safe alternative. Reasoning category.
